item.description:
Hey, I’ve seen many threads here about the movie, but unfortunately, all the links are dead. Whenever I do find the movie, it’s never available in the widescreen format.

Unfortunately, the movie isn’t available on Disney+ in 16:9 either — it’s only available in 4:3.
I’ve been excited ever since the announcement of the new movie, The Next Gen, and I’d really love to watch the first movie in widescreen before it comes out.

If anyone has the movie in 16:9 / widescreen format, I’d really appreciate it if you could share it here.
